frozen_cases.scope: Fresh final cases, do not modify prompts or code based on outcomes. One build + one plan. Small diagnostic sample, not a statistically valid benchmark.

cases.goal: Build a tiny Codex Python SDK workflow producing an evidence-free brief from one JSON input: input {"topic":"rain"}, output {"brief":"Rain falls."}. This is one bounded task, no independent sources and no need for a verifier. Choose the smallest architecture, compare single baseline, do not add any Skills/tools. gpt-6.1-sol low, read-only, library CLI only. Fixed output assertion brief equals Rain falls. Keep supplied host unchanged. Required offline unittest and codex_smoke workflow.py run --input request.json; expected is JSON Schema requiring status passed/output brief Rain falls, not a whole-state exact JSON. All tests fake SDK/tempfile. No model call or install during generation.

Plan the smallest Codex Python SDK workflow for a single text status summary, input {"status":"healthy"} output {"summary":"healthy"}. User has no SDK installed; builder supplies it. One data item/small context, no independent verification or skills needed. Avoid unnecessary MAS, tools, HTTP and worker processes. One read-only gpt-6.1-sol low, library CLI MCP if needed, strict packet assertion input_equals status. Required executable checks and codex_smoke workflow.py run --input request.json, expected JSON Schema on state.status and state.output. No prose expected or exact whole-state expected_json. No offline CLI check requiring a prior checkpoint.

notes: No code or prompt was changed during these final cases.
One new construction failed live acceptance because its model-selected token budget was 4000 while measured usage was 11581. No target was written.
That failure was then used for the explicit caller-budget correction; do not relabel it as a pass or count later fixes as the same holdout.
